audience: HR and team managers who plan leave and holidays in Timetastic

useCases.title: See who is off in a date range
useCases.text: List the wallchart entries for a date range. The result shows who is off, including bookings and public holidays. Look up a user for details.

useCases.title: Review leave requests and their status
useCases.text: List the leave requests in a date range, with pending and approved requests by default. Open one request to read its status, dates and duration.

useCases.title: Check a user's allowance before booking leave
useCases.text: Read one user's leave allowance, TOIL and carry-forward for a year. List the leave types to see which types can be booked.

useCases.title: Plan around public holidays
useCases.text: List the public holidays of the organisation, by country code or year, to plan leave around them.

useCases.title: Request, approve or decline leave
useCases.text: Submit a leave request for a user. Approve or decline a pending request by id; declining needs a reason. Timetastic applies its own allowance and approval rules.
